description: Audit the public DNS records and TLS certificate of ONE public hostname, using bounded DNS resolution and a TLS handshake to port 443. Use for a basic hostname/certificate check; do not use for web content fetching (web_fetch), page extraction (web_extract), vulnerability scanning, port scanning or private IP networks. Input is a hostname such as example.com, not a URL. Returns TLS validity, resolved public IPs, TLS version and certificate expiry where available; no HTTP request. Costs 0.05 native USDC via x402 v2 on Base or Solana MCP.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com; no URL, IP, credentials or private host.

name: domain_dns_tls_audit
title: Public domain DNS and TLS audit
